title: Crunchy Cashew Mediterranean Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with crunchy cashews, sweet mediterranean vegetables, and a hint of tangy flavors.
instructions: 1. Lay the wrap flat on a clean surface.
2. In a medium bowl, mix together chopped cashews, mediterranean olives, cucumber, feta cheese, tomato, lettuce, and red onion.
3. Squeeze the lemon juice over the mixture and toss to combine.
4. Drizzle the olive oil over the mixture and toss to combine.
5. Spoon the cashew mixture onto the center of the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border on either side.
6. Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
7. Slice the wrap in half and serve immediately.
8. Serve with your favorite side dish, such as a salad or a side of hummus.
